quotations.old_english: Biþ sió wamb áþened and hrǽctaþ gelóme
quotations.english: the stomach is extended and they eructate frequently

source_text: hrǽctan; p. te To eructate, retch :-- Biþ sió wamb áþened and hrǽctaþ gelóme the stomach is extended and they eructate frequently, L. M. 2, 28; Lchdm. ii. 224, 12.
